where: crates/blaze-cas/src/lib.rs Store::place / names_step, crates/blaze-cas/src/whole.rs, crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/job.rs Jobs::place
what: The store kept a whole file (placed/<content>, .derived) of every output it ever placed by cloning unless the daemon remembered to call Store::unplace / unplace_made with the path's last key; the collector's placed roots were a set of keys, so a key placed at two paths lost its root when one path was replaced. A hello-world home held 917 MB, 314 MB of it whole and derived files.
cost: disk 12x the competitor's on hello world; the planted set bug unguarded
cause: who names a cached file was the caller's bookkeeping (an unplace call per path) instead of the store's own record of what each path was placed from
class: a cache's lifetime kept by the caller asking for deletion, and a reference count kept as a set
prevention: the place routes count names per path themselves (whole::Names, listed in placed/names); no API lets a caller drop a cached file
fix: Names driven by every place route; unplace and unplace_made deleted; Collecting::placed replaced by Store::place_keys (one entry a path); the open sweeps content-named files the listing does not name. Control: PlacePlant::OneName (place_crash's oracle `bounded`) and whole.rs's plant_one_name.
